name: dsh-meta-market
description: A Web4 inter-system layer: independently operated harness instances recognise each other as peers, conduct bounded and refusable dialogues, align their meta-packages to a shared 24-zone intent map, and exchange those packages as reviewable, reversible patches.

scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build && pnpm run verify
